messages:
Maya K: Quick checkpoint on model onboarding + catalog launch — who has final signoff on licensing for the two new open models (orchid-7b, ember-3b)? Need owners & perf profile readiness by EOD tomorrow.
Jon P: I'm owner for orchid-7b perf profiling. I pushed perf runs yesterday — see <https://github.com/redwood/inference/benchmarks/pull/412>. Numbers look solid on A100 80GB, still noisy on 3090.
Lina C: Legal says ember-3b has a restrictive TOU clause. @Sam R can you confirm if we can host it in Hosted API?
LicenseBot: license-check ember-3b -> FLAGGED: inbound TOU; manual review required.
Sam R: I'll take ember-3b review. Pinged legal@redwood and added notes in the intake doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/model-intake/ember-3b
Alex T: For catalog UX we need the perf profile JSON (latency, mem, tokens/sec) and a short blurb about recommended quantization. @Jon P can you attach?
Jon P: attaching snippet:
```json
{"model":"orchid-7b","avg_latency_ms":72,"tokens_per_sec":4200,"recommended_quant":"8bit"}
```
Maya K: Perfect. Lina — any ETA on legal for ember?
Lina C: Legal needed 48h from now. I put it in the queue; will try to accelerate if Sam adds risk mitigations.
Sam R: Added KV-cache usage notes and data retention statement. Also opened PR: <https://github.com/redwood/catalog/pull/88> for catalog entry schema updates. Needs review from @Alex T and @Maya K.
Alex T: Reviewing now, will leave inline comments by EOD. Main ask: add 'quant_profile' field and 'license_url'.
Maya K: Can we list owners for launch checklist: PR review, perf docs, license signoff, rollout policy?
Jon P: Owners: PR review = Alex T, perf docs = Jon P, license = Lina C/Sam R, rollout policy = Maya K.
Lina C: +1. Also suggest canary region = eu-west-1 only for first 24h.
Sam R: Noted. Also we should add automatic fallback to a lower-cost variant if latency breaches SLO.
Maya K: Good call. Action items: Sam — finish legal notes; Jon — finalize perf profile + upload to catalog; Alex — merge schema PR; Lina — confirm license signoff; I'll schedule a 15-min pre-launch tomorrow 10:30 PST. :calendar:
Alex T: Added review comments, quick LGTM on schema after small change.
Jon P: Perf artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-perf/orchid-7b/2026-04-01/results.json
LicenseBot: license-status orchid-7b -> CLEAR
Maya K: Thanks all. If anything slips ping here. We'll move to canary if all green. :thumbsup:
